item.title: Buying a laptop in 2026 requires more than checking whether it has a high-end processor
item.description: A Core Ultra 7 or Ryzen 7 badge does not tell you how fast a laptop really is. Processor generation and suffix, GPU power limits, VRAM, RAM type and channel configuration, SSD technology, cooling, display quality, battery capacity, and upgradeability can matter just as much as the headline CPU name.

item.title: The most responsible AI may be the smallest one that works

item.title: The greenest upgrade may be the one you do not buy

item.title: Passkeys move security closer to how people actually live
